backend/main.mo: Defines product, order, and profile types; manages products, user profiles, and orders with access control and initialization logic.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature-to-file mappings, components, and test IDs for implemented frontend and auth features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of all major frontend files and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the root React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, global providers, and the main application layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login, logout, and state display.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Prompts new authenticated users to enter their name and saves the profile.
frontend/src/components/common/AccessDen: Displays a sign‑in prompt when a user tries to access a protected page.
frontend/src/components/common/NotFoundS: Presents a 404 page with navigation back to the storefront.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Header with navigation, cart button, login, and user greeting based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps pages with header, footer, and profile modal, providing main site layout.
frontend/src/components/orders/OrderStat: Displays an order’s progress or cancellation using a step-based status timeline.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthz.ts: Provides simple authentication status and a default unauthorized message.
frontend/src/hooks/useCart.ts: Returns cart context and ensures hook is used inside CartProvider.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and exposes the current user's profile loading state and data.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, login/clear functions, and identity state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useOrders.ts: Fetches caller orders and individual order details using query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Loads all products and provides helper to find a product by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for products, profiles, orders, and mutations using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility for merging CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, Internet Identity provider, and React Query client.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays the shopping cart, allowing quantity updates, item removal, and navigation to checkout or product browsing when empty.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Handles checkout with delivery info form validation, order creation, and navigation to confirmation after successful submission.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Shows a list of the user's past orders with status, totals, and navigation to product browsing or order details.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays order confirmation details including the order ID and provides links to continue shopping or view the order.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Presents detailed information for a specific order, including items, totals, delivery info, and status timeline.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Shows full product details, including images and pricing, and allows adding the item to the cart if available.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Implements the storefront UI with product search, category filtering, product listing, and add‑to‑cart actions.
frontend/src/state/cart/CartProvider.tsx: Provides cart context with item management, quantity updates, persistence syncing, and subtotal/item count calculation.
frontend/src/state/cart/cartStorage.ts: Handles saving, loading, and clearing cart data in sessionStorage, including bigint restoration.
frontend/src/state/cart/cartTypes.ts: Defines cart item and cart state TypeScript interfaces.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the project’s UI style system.
project_state.json: Describes the project state, implemented features, requirements, and image assets needed for the shopping and delivery app.
